checks.result: New catalog method uses existing FlowClient.request/transportInit with a per-request exact X-Flow-Execution-Profile header and URLSearchParams. It parses the finite public catalog schema and rejects legacy/wrong protocol envelopes. Existing legacy/steering/native methods and publication transport remain unchanged; no fallback or retry was added.

Send retains its pre-existing single JSON serialization and comparison against parsed sent bytes. Opt-in enqueue uses the same pattern and exact settings matcher; mutation of the caller object during HTTP cannot change the receipt comparison. Legacy enqueue keeps its old request/error path. No automatic command key generation or retry is introduced by the new conversation CLI mutations.

Opt-in queue receipt verifies conversation identity, UUID item identity, expected revision + 1, sequence, initial waiting/unpromoted state, timestamps, exact settings and exact preview/truncation. Replayed immutable acceptance is not compared with later current queue promotion. Malformed successful JSON or mismatched acknowledgement remains unconfirmed; conflict and abort retain transport errors. Raw acknowledgement data is not echoed in the new CLI unknown message.

CLOSED at 563b1ea151d8d26a2100238d8faf26b697f38d71. The decoder now computes the longest complete code-point prefix within 512 UTF-8 bytes and requires exact equality plus exact truncated boolean. It rejects a shorter valid prefix and a half-surrogate slice of a valid input code point. The unchanged center itemView loop was inspected as a direct semantic reference. Original 2 failures and subsequent 2 selected passes (6 unselected) are preserved; no reviewer rerun.

The shared schemas constrain the optional complete settings snapshot and observed initialization. The receipt matcher requires exact requested settings identity, validates observed source/fields, rejects contradictory effective.model and runnerRequested wrappers, and never fills absence/null from the requested model/effort/speed. Ordinary GET readers remain transparent and old records remain unmodified.

Three new conversation commands reuse existing FlowClient, readJsonInput, parseArgs, schemas and signal. Send is follow-up only; mutations require explicit stable key and bounded regular UTF-8 JSON (131072 bytes). Acceptance output does not mean execution. Missing key/invalid input are local failures; unknown receipt and HTTP errors are nonzero without hidden retries. Old CLI code is retained; O14 goalCommand, its dedicated test, and original README prefix were independently compared exactly.

All 100 manifest entries match their fixed blobs/bytes/SHA256 and current files: 9 owned, 59 protected, 32 evidence. CORE six contracts match their exact ea276572 input, without granting CORE approval. Source changes outside the 9 owned paths are limited to this task plan/evidence. New HTTP tests use ephemeral loopback ports and close owned servers/connections; file cases remove own temporary directories. No new dependency or lock changes.
